newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LIONS SCRUMMAGE WILL BE UNDER MICROSCOPE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS SCRUMMAGE WILL BE UNDER MICROSCOPE.

text.p: The British Lions scrummage will be under the microscope when they face Mpumalanga in the fourth match of their South African tour in Witbank on Wednesday.
The home side, formerly known as South Eastern Transvaal, have a reputation for fielding big and physical packs who will look to exploit the Lions' perceived frailties up front.

The tourists were repeatedly shunted backwards on their own scrum put-in in Saturday's 38-21 victory over Western Province and underwent an intense scrummaging session at altitude in Pretoria on Monday.

"Obviously we recognise the scrum is an area we have to work on but it's certainly not a weakness," said number eight Tim Rodber who becomes the Lions' fourth captain in as many matches when he leads the side out on Wednesday.
"We just need to sort ourselves out and the Monday session took a big step towards doing that. Hopefully Wednesday will prove it.
"If you watched the training you will see that we worked hard and that we are preparing ourselves for a very physical contest.
"They have a very big pack and will want to put us under pressure and that's why we trained as we did."
The Mpumalanga game begins a three match countdown to the emergence of the Lions team for the first test on June 21.
They face Northern Transvaal in Pretoria on Saturday and and take on the Gauteng Lions (formerly Transvaal) in Johannesburg a week on Wednesday.
By then coach Ian McGeechan expects to be able to name his strongest XV to enable them to play a test dress rehearsal match against South African provincial champions Natal on June 14.
"The next three games are crucial to us as to how we form our test 15," said coach Ian McGeechan.
The Lions have won all three matches to tour on date scoring 12 tries and conceding five.

Mpumalanga - 15-Eben von Gericke; 14-Johan Visage, 13-Riaan Potgieter, 12-Gerry Gendall, 11-Polla Nel; 10-Rynhard van As, 9-Dan van Zyl; 8-Tobie Oosthuizen (captain), 7-Piet Joubert, 6-Francois Rossouw, 5-Elandre van der Bergh, 4-Marius Bosman, 3-AndreBotha, 2-Henry Kemp, 1-Hakjies Swart.
